```{r doc-code, include=FALSE}
source("../code/R/doc_code.R")
```

All panels are produced by
[`script/Figure2.R`](https://github.com/dzemmour/immgenT-cosmo-paper/blob/main/script/Figure2.R).
The code below is shown for reference (not re-executed on this page); the
images are its pre-rendered output.

Panels **2d** (TCRαβ clonotype sharing between lineages) and **2g** (expanded
clonotypes on the all-T MDE) come from the TCR analysis and are not reproduced
here.

Lineage abbreviations used throughout: CD4, conventional CD4⁺ T cells; CD8,
conventional CD8αβ⁺ T cells; Treg, CD4⁺Foxp3⁺ regulatory T cells; CD8aa, CD8αα
αβ T cells; gdT, γδ T cells; Tz, Zbtb16⁺ αβ T cells; DN, CD4⁻CD8αβ⁻ αβ T cells;
DP, CD4⁺CD8αβ⁺ αβ T cells.

## Setup

```{r fig2-setup, code=code_for("../script/Figure2.R", c("^", "Load data")), eval=FALSE}
```

## (A) All-T MDE by lineage {#fig2a}

```{r fig2a-code, code=code_for("../script/Figure2.R", "2a"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r fig2a-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="50%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/Figure2/2a_MDE_level1.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 2A.** Reference minimum-distortion embedding of all profiled T cells
(the all-T MDE), coloured by T-cell lineage.
:::

## (B) Surface markers by lineage {#fig2b}

```{r fig2b-code, code=code_for("../script/Figure2.R", "2b"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r fig2b-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="32%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c("assets/Figure2/2b_FeatureScatter_TCRB_TCRGD.png",
                          "assets/Figure2/2b_FeatureScatter_CD4_CD8B.png",
                          "assets/Figure2/2b_FeatureScatter_CD8A_CD8B.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 2B.** Expression of cell surface markers in the CITE-seq data
(log1p(CP10K)), cells coloured by lineage as in (A). Dashed lines mark the
protein positivity thresholds; the lineage annotation is derived from the joint
RNA/protein latent space, not from these gates.
:::

## (C) Canonical lineage transcripts {#fig2c}

```{r fig2c-code, code=code_for("../script/Figure2.R", "2c"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r fig2c-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="70%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/Figure2/2c_FeaturePlot_lineage_markers.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 2C.** All-T MDE colour-coded by RNA expression of canonical lineage
transcripts (Trdc, Cd8b1, Cd4, Zbtb16, Cd8a and Foxp3), capped at the 95th
percentile.
:::

## (E) Mki67 marks proliferating cells {#fig2e}

```{r fig2e-code, code=code_for("../script/Figure2.R", "2e"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r fig2e-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="45%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/Figure2/2e_FeaturePlot_Mki67.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 2E.** Mki67 expression on the all-T MDE, highlighting proliferating
cells. These form their own region of the embedding irrespective of lineage.
:::

## (F) CD62L/CD44 single-positive populations {#fig2f}

```{r fig2f-code, code=code_for("../script/Figure2.R", "2f"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r fig2f-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="32%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c("assets/Figure2/2f_gate_CD62L_CD44.png",
                          "assets/Figure2/2f_MDE_CD62Lpos_CD44neg.png",
                          "assets/Figure2/2f_MDE_CD44pos_CD62Lneg.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 2F.** All-T MDE with CD62L⁺CD44⁻ (centre) and CD44⁺CD62L⁻ (right) T
cells highlighted as cell density, gated as shown in the adjacent CD62L versus
CD44 protein expression plot (left; CITE-seq, log1p(CP10K)). Naive- and
experienced-phenotype cells occupy distinct territories within every lineage.
:::

## (H) Colonic T cells before and after integration {#fig2h}

```{r fig2h-code, code=code_for("../script/Figure2.R", "2h"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r fig2h-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="24%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c("assets/Figure2/2h_IGT20_UMAP_RNAclusters.png",
                          "assets/Figure2/2h_IGT20_MDE_level1.png",
                          "assets/Figure2/2h_IGT27_UMAP_RNAclusters.png",
                          "assets/Figure2/2h_IGT27_MDE_level1.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 2H.** Colonic T cells at baseline profiled in two independent
experiments (IGT20, first pair; IGT27, second pair). For each: the
pre-integration UMAP computed on that experiment alone with its own de novo
clusters, and the post-integration representation of the same cells on the
all-T MDE, coloured by lineage as in (A). The same states are recovered from
both experiments despite their independent clusterings.
:::
